changelog:
Initial release featuring a library of professional business email templates.

- Offers ready-to-send templates for cold outreach, follow-ups, meeting requests, project updates, rescheduling, declining requests, and introductions
- Provides multiple tone options and subject lines for versatility
- Includes practical email best practices for effective communication
- Templates are industry-neutral and easy to customize for any business situation
summary: Professional email templates for common business situations. Perfect for sales, customer service, networking, and internal communication.
